name: Connection Mapper
tagline: Charts every direct and one-hop path between any two people or companies
description: Name two people, two companies, or a person and an organization, and choose which kinds of ties matter to you, such as employment, investment or membership. It then maps the direct links between them plus every friend-of-a-friend route one step removed, working from what is publicly findable.
author: MindandEmotion7
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
